title: Travel Actions
description: Actions used in travel and country reasoning.

entries.title: Travel
entries.description: Move, journey, or visit a place.

entries.title: Depart
entries.description: Leave a place or set out on a journey.

entries.title: Arrive
entries.description: Reach a destination or end point.

entries.title: Cross
entries.description: Cross a border, checkpoint, or boundary.

entries.title: Board
entries.description: Get on a flight, train, bus, or ship.

entries.title: Land
entries.description: Touch down or arrive by flight.

entries.title: Stay
entries.description: Remain in a place during travel.

entries.title: Migrate
entries.description: Move to a new country or region for residence.

entries.title: Reside
entries.description: Live in or settle within a place.

entries.title: Study Abroad
entries.description: Attend study, training, or education outside the home country.

entries.title: Tour
entries.description: Visit places as a tourist or visitor.

entries.title: Compare Countries
entries.description: Compare one country, city, or culture with another.

entries.title: Mock
entries.description: Ridicule or make fun of a country or its people.

entries.title: Document
entries.description: Record or report a travel scene factually.

entries.title: Observe
entries.description: Describe what is seen without judgment.

entries.title: Report
entries.description: Communicate travel facts in a factual register.
